data.name: Abacus formatted tables and columnar storage

implementation_design.status: Accepted design baseline; implementation, resource budgets and performance qualification pending.
implementation_design.scope: Formatted-table tabs coexist with freeform sparse worksheet tabs. Independently implemented historical Abacus format; no dependency on modern Parquet libraries or claim of Parquet compatibility.

schema.column_identity: Stable column ID, name, declared data type and nullability; stable row IDs survive sorting/filtering.
schema.rules: Specify rounding, collation, overflow, null/error semantics and checked conversions; preserve leading-zero identifiers as text.

storage.page_role: Smallest compression/encoding unit; byte-bounded buffers and dictionaries. Group/page sizes require measurement on target RAM and disks.
storage.footer: Versioned schema, chunk/page locations and supported min/max/null-count statistics. Bound metadata memory and permit incremental access.
storage.column_pruning: Read output columns plus all predicate, join and formula dependencies.
storage.block_skipping: Skip only when valid conservative statistics prove no match; handle nulls, sort order and pending edits. Predicate pushdown evaluates filters early and is distinct from statistics-based skipping.
storage.encoding: Dictionary, RLE, bit packing and suitable numeric encodings with uncompressed fallback. Compression is dataset-dependent; no guaranteed 75–90% reduction or heavy codec requirement.
storage.execution: Stream and batch scans; bound dictionaries, query state and join memory. Use temporary disk storage or report resource limits; do not require whole tables or row groups resident.
storage.editing: Use a bounded edit buffer/change log with stable row IDs; merge pending changes into reads. Rewrite affected storage on save/compaction, update or invalidate statistics and preserve a consistent visible snapshot.
storage.recovery: Validate replacement data and footer before recoverable replacement; retain prior valid version until success. Do not publish incomplete metadata or silently skip corrupt blocks.

calculation.syntax: Abacus native expressions or documented SQL expression subset with shared type, decimal, null and error rules.
calculation.virtual_columns: Side-effect-free row expressions; track dependencies and reject cycles. Values computed on demand; persisted statistics require valid materialization.
calculation.lookups: Scalar lookup requires unique-key relationship; missing keys and duplicate keys have explicit behavior, never arbitrary first-match selection.
calculation.joins: One-to-many/many-to-many joins produce derived query tables rather than silently changing scalar column cardinality.
calculation.sql_scope: Read-only SELECT projections, WHERE filters, GROUP BY aggregates and equijoins over local formatted tables; document supported syntax and resource limits. No claim of complete SQL standard or general transaction engine.

nested_data.launch: Flat typed columns; reserve versioned extension points for nested values.
nested_data.later: Bounded arrays, maps and structs with explicit depth/size limits, expandable presentation, indexing, null and aggregation semantics; implementation milestone not yet dated.
